visual_identity.silhouette: short bob haircut, practical rain jacket, narrow shoulder bag
visual_identity.wardrobe: dark hooded rain jacket, pale scarf, ankle boots
recurring_details: small crescent hair clip above left temple
right hand usually carries the brass ticket punch when the prop is present

continuity_notes: Hair clip remains visible unless hood covers it.
Scarf should stay pale against black-and-white tones.

dramatic_profile.external_goal: Identify who or what triggered the impossible station bell.
dramatic_profile.internal_need: Trust her own perception without hiding uncertainty behind procedure.
dramatic_profile.core_fear: That following the warning will confirm someone was lost because she hesitated.
dramatic_profile.stakes: Ignoring the bell could leave a returning traveler trapped beyond the tunnel.
dramatic_profile.flaw: She converts fear into rigid certainty before she has enough evidence.
dramatic_profile.contradiction: She appears methodical while choosing to confront an event that defies every rule.
moral_limits: She will not knowingly use another person as bait.
dramatic_profile.arc_direction: Move from solitary certainty toward evidence-based trust in Ren.
voice_principles: Names the rule before challenging it
relationship_drivers: Needs Ren's skepticism to test her conclusions
Protects Ren by withholding how afraid she is
